clue.text: Hospital bill rising in city

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the pieces are read from bottom to top

parts.note: H is the standard abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
a tab is a bill run up at a bar or restaurant

explanation.surface: A patient's hospital bill keeps climbing in some city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns HTAB upwards. BATH is a spa city in Somerset, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Bath is an example of a city, the historic Roman spa in south-west England.

clue.text: Gents are abandoned, cut off

indicators.note: abandoned suggests letters set loose without restraint, so the words gents are get rearranged

explanation.surface: Some men have been abandoned and left isolated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned' scrambles GENTSARE.
explanation.definitionFit: To estrange someone is to alienate them, cutting them off from family or friends.

clue.text: Mathematician's achievement displayed outside empty room

indicators.note: displayed outside says the first piece is shown wrapped round the second

parts.note: a feat is an achievement

indicators.note: an empty word loses its insides, keeping only the first and last letters of room

explanation.surface: A mathematician's great achievement put on show outside a vacant room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'empty' strips the inside of 'room'; 'displayed outside' wraps the achievement round what is left. The 's stands for 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Pierre de Fermat was a 17th-century French mathematician, famed for his Last Theorem.

clue.text: Surrendered or carried on for an extended period?

definitions.meaning: gave in, as a dog does lying on its back in submission

definitions.text: carried on for an extended period?
definitions.meaning: describes something, like a loan or debt, extended into a further term

explanation.surface: Someone either gave in or kept going for a long time.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is a playful reading: a debt or contract carried forward into a new period.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are idioms: to capitulate submissively, and to extend a financial arrangement into a new term.

clue.text: Possibly Greek girl hugged by top officer

indicators.note: hugged by says the girl is wrapped inside the officer

parts.note: CIC is commander-in-chief, the top officer
lass is a girl, especially in northern England and Scotland

explanation.surface: A Greek girl in the arms of a senior officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' signals a definition by example: Greek is one kind of classic, as in the Greek classics.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancient Greek literature and architecture are the archetypal examples of the classic style.

clue.text: Soldier sat on by my dog

indicators.note: in a down clue, the soldier sat on by the next piece means it comes below it

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like my!
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier being sat on by my pet dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'my!' and 'cor!' are both British cries of surprise. In a down answer, 'sat on by' puts the exclamation above the soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A corgi is a breed of short-legged Welsh dog, famously kept by the late Queen.

clue.text: Music establishment showing overreactions when reformed

indicators.note: something reformed is formed again in a new shape, so the letters of overreactions are rearranged

explanation.surface: A music school shows people overreacting once it is reorganised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when reformed' rearranges OVERREACTIONS.
explanation.definitionFit: A conservatoire is a college for advanced training in music performance.

clue.text: Individual backing church, a biblical figure

indicators.note: backing means going in reverse, so the word for an individual is read backwards

parts.note: one is a single individual

explanation.surface: A lone person supports the church, as a figure from the Bible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns ONE into ENO.
explanation.definitionFit: Enoch appears in Genesis as the father of Methuselah, taken up by God.

clue.text: Lady issuing invitations — thus husband is upset about groups turning up

indicators.note: about means placed around, so the first piece wraps the second
in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the letters are read bottom to top

parts.note: so means thus
H is the abbreviation for husband in genealogies

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up reverses the word upward

parts.note: sets are groups

explanation.surface: A lady sending invitations, while her husband is upset by groups arriving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' makes HOS; 'turning up' makes STES; 'about' wraps the first round the second. 'is' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A hostess is the woman who invites and receives guests at a party.

clue.text: Sly monarch giving a sign

parts.note: arch means slyly knowing or mischievous
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the monarch

explanation.surface: A cunning king or queen makes a gesture.
explanation.walkthrough: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the monarch. 'a sign' looks like a gesture but means a sign of the zodiac.
explanation.definitionFit: The Archer is Sagittarius, one of the twelve signs of the zodiac.

clue.text: Unidentified rogue salesmen

indicators.note: rogue means behaving wildly out of control, so the letters of salesmen run amok

explanation.surface: Some crooked salesmen who have not been identified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rogue' rearranges SALESMEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with no name has not been identified; anonymous and unnamed are synonyms.

clue.text: Unhappy knight taking shelter after party

indicators.note: after says the knight and shelter come later than the party

parts.note: a disco is a dance party
N is the chess notation for knight
a tent is a shelter

explanation.surface: A knight is miserable sheltering after a party.
explanation.walkthrough: N is knight in chess notation. 'Discontent' is used here as an adjective, a rarer form of discontented.
explanation.definitionFit: Discontent as an adjective means dissatisfied, a synonym for unhappy with one's lot.

clue.text: Quality of thick liquid in a pit absorbed by plant

indicators.note: absorbed by means taken inside, so the pit goes within the plant

parts.note: cress is a salad plant
a mine is a pit

explanation.surface: Something about a thick liquid in a pit soaked up by a plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quality of thick liquid' reads as part of the scene but is the definition, a noun for a texture.
explanation.definitionFit: Creaminess is the smooth richness that a thick liquid such as custard or cream has.

clue.text: Performer looking shamefaced about hiding love

indicators.note: hiding means concealing within, so love goes inside
about means turned round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: red describes a face flushed with shame
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: An actor blushing with shame about concealing a love affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns RED into DER; 'hiding' puts O inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A doer is one who performs actions, someone active rather than merely talking.

clue.text: They'll keep getting into jams

parts.note: sounds like people forever in trouble, but means additives put into fruit preserves so they keep longer

explanation.surface: Some people who are always landing themselves in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keep' means stay fresh and 'jams' are fruit spreads, not tight spots.
explanation.definitionFit: Additives like sugar or pectin are put into jams to stop them spoiling, so they keep.

clue.text: Empty talk from friend having claim

parts.note: a pal is a friend
to aver is to claim or assert

explanation.surface: Idle chatter from a friend who is making some claim.
explanation.definitionFit: Palaver means tedious fuss or idle chatter, much ado about nothing.

clue.text: Nervous type who is outdoors with binoculars?

definitions.meaning: an obsessive birdwatcher out in the field

explanation.surface: An anxious person out and about with field glasses.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the slang for a keen birdwatcher, one who chases rare sightings, is twitcher.
explanation.definitionFit: Twitcher means both someone jittery and a dedicated birdwatcher in British slang.

clue.text: Strike that involves a lot of tricks

definitions.text: that involves a lot of tricks
definitions.meaning: in bridge, a grand ... wins all thirteen tricks, a small ... twelve

explanation.surface: A blow from someone full of tricks.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge, winning all or all but one of the tricks is called a grand or small slam.
explanation.definitionFit: Slam means to strike forcefully, and in bridge it is the bid taking nearly all tricks.

clue.text: Top men in power meeting a horrible rich star

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for power in physics

indicators.note: horrible suggests something ugly and mangled, so rich star is rearranged

explanation.surface: Leaders in power meet an unpleasant wealthy celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horrible' rearranges RICHSTAR into TRIARCHS.
explanation.definitionFit: Patriarchs are the male heads of families or communities, the senior figures.

clue.text: Factories producing line in underwear

indicators.note: in places the line inside the underwear

parts.note: pants are underwear (in British usage, underpants)

explanation.surface: Factories turning out a range of underwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'line' looks like a product range but is just L. In British English pants are underpants.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant is an industrial works or factory, as in a manufacturing plant.

clue.text: There's little good in cad posing as philosopher

indicators.note: in places the small letter inside the word for a cad

parts.note: a heel is a cad, a dishonourable man
G is the short form of good

explanation.surface: A bounder pretending to be a philosopher has little goodness in him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts G inside HEEL.
explanation.definitionFit: Georg Hegel was the German idealist philosopher known for his dialectic.

clue.text: Awful snag with evil character seeking control

indicators.note: awful suggests something badly made, so the letters of snag and evil are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dreadful problem with a wicked person who wants to dominate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Awful' rearranges SNAG and EVIL together.
explanation.definitionFit: Svengali, the hypnotist in du Maurier's novel Trilby, is a byword for someone who manipulates and controls another.

clue.text: Accusation of assault

definitions.meaning: a formal allegation of an offence
a headlong attack, as a cavalry rush

explanation.surface: Someone is accused of attacking another.
explanation.definitionFit: A charge is both a criminal indictment and a rushing attack on an enemy.

clue.text: Social worker interrupted by superior female

indicators.note: interrupted by means broken into, so superior goes inside

parts.note: an ant is a social insect, a worker in its colony
U means upper class or superior in British usage

explanation.surface: A social worker is cut short by a senior woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Social worker' is an ant, a colony insect; U is British shorthand for upper class.
explanation.definitionFit: An aunt is a female relative, the sister of a parent.

clue.text: Engineers getting TV tuned in afresh?

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
a TV set is a television

explanation.surface: Engineers re-tuning a television.
explanation.walkthrough: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps.
explanation.definitionFit: To reset a dial or device is to adjust it again from scratch, as when retuning.

clue.text: Enduring scene's central feature — bird by a lake

indicators.note: the central feature of a word is its middle letter

parts.note: a tern is a seabird
L is the abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A bird beside a lake is the focus of the scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'central feature' picks E, the middle of 'scene'.
explanation.definitionFit: Eternal means everlasting, lasting for ever, a synonym for enduring.
